entries.text: A tiling texture's grout shows the Part's BASE Color underneath - set the part to the palette's light tone BEFORE painting or the surface reads dark regardless of texture colors.

Walled interiors go pitch-black under evening ClockTime + dense Atmosphere: keep interiors readable with ClockTime 14-15, Ambient >= 100, and point lights as accents only - never primary illumination.

paint_texture custom primary/secondary colors can silently produce a BLACK texture (draw-ops fail) - use the curated default palettes, and if a painted surface renders black with a specular glint suspect the texture not the lighting.

Lighting.Technology and LightingStyle are RobloxScriptSecurity (engine-locked above PluginSecurity) - no tool or Luau at plugin level can read or write them; accept the place default or ask the user to change it in Studio's Properties pane.
